title: Final bounded visual review of PDF pages1–112
page_number_convention: All page numbers in this report are physical PDF pages,1-based; printed book page numbers and original margin numbers differ.

observations.check: Title, contents, chapter/section numbering and heading hierarchy
observations.result: Hierarchy and running heads remain visually distinct; contents entries and chapter starts fit the page. No clipped heading or overlapping number observed in overview.

observations.check: X corrected completed-field hat, Z/ell, rational-field base and q>cdqcX+1
observations.result: Corrected symbols are legible at full-page scale; hats and primes remain distinguishable. The page7 groups/spectral-sequence diagrams have separated arrows and labels; the page11 +1 range fits its text line.

observations.check: XI corrected map letter, graph prime, external citation numbers, epsilon functors, pi_n and bibliography digits
observations.result: Full-page views show the lower-case map f, X-prime graph target, epsilon bases, pi_n homotopy term and345/79 bibliography digits clearly. No inserted symbol collides with neighboring indices or punctuation.

observations.check: XII corrected5.3 reference plus dense comparison diagrams and cohomology exact sequences
observations.result: The5.3 reference is visually rendered as5.2 with the intended ordinary reference styling. Dense diagrams and long formula rows stay within the text region, with visible arrowheads and distinct labels.

observations.check: XIV proof bound≤0 and rectified dimension delta
observations.result: Both corrected bound and delta render legibly. The triangle diagram and the following spectral-sequence display retain separate labels and equation marks.

observations.check: XV parenthesized1.6(iii), tildes on localized fiber criterion, finite affine family wording
observations.result: Corrected1.6(iii) is visible. Multiple tildes and subscripts remain distinguishable in the corollary. Revised finite-family sentence wraps within the text column without overflow.

observations.check: XVI equation4.2, q≠0,1 proof range and GodementR bibliography entry
observations.result: The visible4.2 reference, comma-separated degree exclusions and R initial render clearly; page94 cases display, footnote and spectral-sequence material do not collide.

observations.check: XVII dense indexed formulas, cases, equation numbering and diagram labels
observations.result: Subscript/superscript clusters, long sums and case braces are legible in full-page PNGs. Equation numbers stay separate from formula bodies; the contraction square labels are distinguishable.

These are consistent with title verso and recto chapter/bibliography organization; no visible content cropped off a neighboring page. They are not treated as missing translation based on blank appearance alone.

limitations: All112 pages were viewed through the seven contact sheets;23 selected pages were additionally viewed as individual PNGs. This is not a full-resolution glyph-by-glyph reading of every page.
The review concerns rendered layout only; it does not repeat the completed mathematical/source adjudication or certify the inherited original assertions.
Blue reference text was visually inspected where present; hyperlink destinations were not tested in this visual pass.
No new compilation was performed by this reviewer; the current PDF hash and298-page count were independently confirmed.
PDF pages113–298 belong to other assigned visual scopes and are not covered here.
